Mana Method, Flame Rune: a rune array of fire forms before you; after a breath a bolt of flame leaves it and GROWS as it flies, wider and harder the further it goes. Sneak to write both runes (pursue and grow). Who may use it is the server's choice: by default your grimoire's mastery (about Stage 3), or the Rune State page, or the late-game Mana Zone gate. Only a grimoire of this element (or a fused one with it as a parent) writes it, unless the server lets every grimoire write all four.
nusmp.mana_method.page.mana_method_water: Mana Method, Water Rune: a rune array of water forms before you; the bolt that leaves it PURSUES the foe nearest your line of fire, turning toward it as it flies. Sneak to write both runes (pursue and grow). Who may use it is the server's choice: by default your grimoire's mastery (about Stage 3), or the Rune State page, or the late-game Mana Zone gate. Only a grimoire of this element (or a fused one with it as a parent) writes it, unless the server lets every grimoire write all four.
Mana Method, Wind Rune: a rune array of wind forms before you; the gale that leaves it PURSUES the foe nearest your line of fire and lifts what it strikes. Sneak to write both runes (pursue and grow). Who may use it is the server's choice: by default your grimoire's mastery (about Stage 3), or the Rune State page, or the late-game Mana Zone gate. Only a grimoire of this element (or a fused one with it as a parent) writes it, unless the server lets every grimoire write all four.
nusmp.mana_method.page.mana_method_earth: Mana Method, Earth Rune: a rune array of earth forms before you; the stone that leaves it GROWS as it flies and slows what it strikes. Sneak to write both runes (pursue and grow). Who may use it is the server's choice: by default your grimoire's mastery (about Stage 3), or the Rune State page, or the late-game Mana Zone gate. Only a grimoire of this element (or a fused one with it as a parent) writes it, unless the server lets every grimoire write all four.
Mana Method, True Magic: a rune array that makes the REAL element of your natural attribute. The bolt ignores magic resistance, devils are highly susceptible, and where it lands it leaves real blocks for a while (water sources, a stone mound, fire, moss) where you may build. Needs Stage 3 control and a natural attribute; the environment's dense mana pays part of the cost.
nusmp.mana_method.page.mana_method_air_s: Mana Method, Air Step Rune: a small rune array forms under your feet and holds you up. Walk on air for a few seconds; sneak to drop. Works for any mage with the Mana Zone gate. Who may use it is the server's choice: by default your grimoire's mastery (about Stage 3), or the Rune State page, or the late-game Mana Zone gate.
Mana Method, Dash Rune: a rune array bursts behind you and throws you forward in your look direction, with a short grace for the fall. Short cooldown. Who may use it is the server's choice: by default your grimoire's mastery (about Stage 3), or the Rune State page, or the late-game Mana Zone gate.
Mana Method, Body Rune (Gadjah's way): rune arrays are written on your own body for a while. Small temporary gifts that grow with the hold: a little more speed, attack, jump, step height, a softer fall and knockback resistance; a full hold also lets you glide down slowly for a moment. A full hold also turns away 15% of each hit you take while the runes last. It is not flight. Costs by the hold. Who may use it is the server's choice: by default your grimoire's mastery (about Stage 3), or the Rune State page, or the late-game Mana Zone gate.
nusmp.mana_method.page.mana_method_brush: Mana Method, Brush Rune (Rill's way): paint a rune array on the surface you look at (floor, wall or ceiling, within 5 blocks). It waits for a while, and when a foe steps into it one bolt of your element leaves it toward them and the array is spent. It never hurts you or your allies. A few at a time; costs by the hold. Who may use it is the server's choice: by default your grimoire's mastery (about Stage 3), or the Rune State page, or the late-game Mana Zone gate.

nusmp.mana_method.page.mana_method_state: Mana Method, Rune State: call the runes. For a few minutes (8 by default) the Mana Method pages answer you, then they must rest before they can be called again (10 minutes by default). Cast it again to see how long is left. The state ends if you log out, die or change dimension, and then the rest begins. Only listed when the server uses the timed mode.
nusmp.mana_method.state.start: Rune State: ON for %s. The runes answer your call.
nusmp.mana_method.state.warn: Rune State: the runes fade in %s.
nusmp.mana_method.state.end: Rune State: OFF. It can be called again in %s.
nusmp.mana_method.state.cooling: Rune State: the runes have not settled yet (%s left).
nusmp.mana_method.state.cut: Rune State: the runes fade early. It can be called again in %s.
